comments.author: @ddunn3489
comments.text: Yes I lived in the Panama Canal Zone from 69 to 82...Oct 1st  1979 when Jimmy Carter finalized the treaty all us Zonians Cried.

replies.author: @Earthcue
replies.text: That’s really wonderful. ❤️ They say distance can make people drift apart, but you’ve managed to stay in touch all these years. I really admire friendships like that.

replies.author: @Earthcue
replies.text: Oh wow, you even made it to a Canal Zone reunion! That says a lot about how special those years were ❤️ Do you still keep in touch with any of your old friends from Panama?

replies.author: @ddunn3489
replies.text: ​@Earthcueyes it went back 83 and 84 and I went to the Canal zone  reunion in Orlando

replies.author: @Earthcue
replies.text: Have you ever been back since ’82? I’d love to know how it felt seeing the place again after all those years.

replies.author: @ddunn3489
replies.text: ​@Earthcueit was paradise.  Can't get good food in the USA the food in Panama was delicious and also Napoli pizza was great

replies.author: @Earthcue
replies.text: You actually lived through that chapter of Canal Zone history, so this really caught my attention. From 1969 to 1982 is a long time too. I can imagine October 1979 felt very different when you were actually there. What do you remember most about that period?
